queries.de: Habe ich das Recht, auf der Straße zu demonstrieren?
queries.fr: Ai-je le droit de manifester dans la rue, liberté de réunion?
queries.it: Ho il diritto di manifestare in strada?
queries.rm: Hav jau il dretg da manifestar en la via?

answer: Yes, the right to demonstrate in the street is guaranteed by Art. 22 of the Swiss Federal Constitution, which protects the freedom of assembly.
model_answer_raw: Yes, the right to demonstrate in the street is guaranteed by Art. 22 of the Swiss Federal Constitution, which protects the freedom of assembly.
